quarterly_data.quarter: SUMCO press release: FY2026 Interim Business Results (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Shareholder report: SUMCO's new factory for leading-edge 300mm wafers (a greenfield investment approved in 2021) is steadily coming online, with full-scale operations expected to begin by 2027; together with facility upgrades at existing plants this is to enhance its ability to serve the leading-edge market.
quarterly_data.figure: new leading-edge 300mm factory: full-scale operations expected by 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: SUMCO press release: FY2026 Interim Business Results (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Shinichi Kubozoe: first-half 2026 results were considerably better than initial market expectations on robust leading-edge (notably AI) wafer demand; payments for greenfield investments are largely complete and free cash flow has steadily improved; the company anticipates a return to the black in fiscal year 2027 and beyond as depreciation costs fall (depreciation expected to peak in fiscal year 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: return to profit anticipated in FY2027 and beyond

quarterly_data.quarter: SUMCO press release: FY2026 Interim Business Results (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President Jiro Ryuta: demand for wafers for leading-edge logic chips and HBM remains strong on AI, and AI-related demand now extends to a wide range of semiconductors such as power control ICs; in wafers for automobiles, industrial equipment and consumer electronics, demand is recovering slowly while Chinese companies are expected to expand supply.
